card.name: Verbs before hedged usefulness statements
card.fires_on: Small verbs or linking words (is, be, used, of, only, considered) right after a drug or test subject, just before a hedge about benefit, use or reliability.

modes.label: Be/is/of before benefit
modes.description: Linking word after a drug name that leads into a statement of benefit or recommendation.
modes.example: Corticosteroids have been shown to be<< of>> benefit in preventing cardiac constriction from tub

modes.label: Used with caution
modes.description: The verb used after 'should be', leading into a caution about use.
modes.example: Corticosteroids should be<< used>> with caution, if at all, in

modes.label: Hedge on a finding or test
modes.description: Word like only or considered that qualifies how often or how reliably something applies.
modes.example: Although hypotension is highly suggestive of cyanide poisoning, it is<< only>> present in a small percentage of cyanide

card.writes: No clear output effect beyond weak, mixed word suggestions.
